node.title: C36' same-fiber collision norms factor through one minimal cyclotomic ideal
node.statement: Let n=2^s, O=Z[zeta_n], pi=1-zeta_n, and P=(p,zeta_n-g) for a selected degree-one prime above an odd p=1 mod n. For distinct unordered exponent pairs with one common shifted product modulo P, let alpha_i be their lifted shifted-product differences relative to one reference and J=(alpha_i). Dyadic shifted-product Sidonicity makes every alpha_i nonzero. Uniformly, J is contained in (pi)^2 P, so 4p divides N(J), while N(J) divides every principal norm |Norm(alpha_i)|. At the complete boundary rich locus (n,p)=(8192,67657729), each of the two ten-pair fibers has gcd 4p already for its first two collision norms, proving that those two obstructions generate (pi)^2 P exactly. This is ideal-level batching and route evidence only; it does not bound the number or quotient weight of rich fibers.
